A1.justification: Both PDFs describe C-3PO and contain readable main texts, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–D. Content can be matched reliably despite substantial reformatting and some relocation.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, out-of-distribution experiments, ablations, inference timings, and training analyses in Section 6 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results and adds C-3PO evaluations on Humanity’s Last Exam in Section 6.6 and Table 4.

M1.justification: The three agents, collaborative strategies, tree rollout, Monte Carlo credit assignment, and PPO training remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 newly summarizes the existing inference procedure rather than introducing a different method.

E1.justification: v2 adds text-only Humanity’s Last Exam evaluation across eight subject categories, extending the existing question-answering coverage. The six in-domain datasets and FreshQA/MultiHop-RAG evaluations are retained.

E2.justification: The new HLE comparison includes Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B baseline rows. Comparator membership in the retained experiments is unchanged. HLE’s proprietary-model rows are explicitly labeled 'For Reference' and do not establish that those systems were evaluated by this work.

E3.justification: The added HLE experiment specifies text-only questions, the official evaluation prompt, Google Search, and a Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct server. Existing training budgets, sample sizes, hyperparameters, and evaluation instructions remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 6.6 adds an OOD transfer check using HLE and the previously untested Qwen2.5-72B server. Existing ablations, efficiency analyses, training dynamics, and depth distributions are unchanged. The ICL-versus-RL analysis is relocated from Appendix C.1 to Section 6.7.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests for performance. The new HLE results retain the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: v2 adds HLE subject scores and averages, including 5.79% for C-3PO, 4.27% for Qwen2.5-72B, and 3.52% for Qwen2.5-7B. Matched pre-existing tables and plotted results remain unchanged, including the relocated ICL-versus-RL comparison.

T1.justification: The cooperative-game formalization, rollout and credit equations, PPO/GAE formulation, and state-transition definitions are retained. Equations (1)–(15) have no substantive mathematical changes, and no new theorem or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about lightweight proxy coordination, tree-based training, efficiency, and plug-and-play generalization. The additional experiment supports this existing contribution scope.

C2.justification: v2 explicitly interprets tree rollout as reallocating sampling from questions to actions at a similar computational budget, with information sharing across paths. It also interprets HLE results as narrowing the open-source/proprietary-model gap. Existing limitations and impact discussion are retained.

D1.justification: Appendix A.4 adds inference pseudocode. Code-access guidance changes from a project-page link and supplementary-material reference to an explicit GitHub repository address. Existing hyperparameter tables, implementation frameworks, and agent prompts are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations including Humanity’s Last Exam, Qwen2.5, AlphaMath, and Learning Evolving Tools, alongside several other recent works. The core positioning against retriever tuning, LLM tuning, and intermediate modules remains unchanged; publication updates to existing references are not new works.

P1.justification: Most prose remains closely matched. Limited changes include expanded sampling explanations, moving the ICL-versus-RL subsection into the main text, adding the HLE and algorithm subsections, and updating author information and acknowledgements.

P2.justification: The main text and references switch from single-column to two-column conference layout, with extensive resizing and repositioning of displays. v2 adds the HLE table and algorithm block, moves the ICL comparison table into the main text, and corrects the ablation chart’s designation from Table 3 to Figure 2.

improvement.justification: The added HLE evaluation broadens empirical coverage, while inference pseudocode and the more visible ICL-versus-RL analysis improve clarity. These are limited gains over an otherwise stable paper. Reference-only proprietary-model scores and absent uncertainty reporting limit the strength of the new HLE interpretation.
